title: EC2 virtual machines
summary: An EC2 instance is a virtual machine. You choose its size and operating-system image, then remain responsible for much of its software upkeep.
introduction: An EC2 instance is a virtual machine. You choose its size and operating-system image, then remain responsible for much of its software upkeep. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
